items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: who do you think won it, Frankie Laine, won the dance marathon and was to go on to become very famous. He was a very nice guy, by the way.

ctx.x: No, at a place, again, the Merry Gardens where they were having a dance marathon, and it paid very well, and he asked me if I could work with him for about a month. Just played for this crazy dance marathon where people danced for days on end without any
sleep, and who do you think won it, Frankie Laine, won the dance marathon and was to go on to become very famous. He was a very nice guy, by the way.
